text.text_excerpt: Great local spot for strong drinks, good food, and great music. Recently went here on a Tuesday night with a friend. We had setups (if you know you know lol) from the bar. We ordered a bunch or different food but the fried ribs were the standout, the wings were a close second though. They even have hookahs if you like that! The service was great! The bartender was super friendly and often came outside to check on us. Plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. I was told they have a DJ on Wednesday, but the mix that was playing was pretty good. Will definitely be back on a Wednesday to hear the DJ. Located on Tulane Ave so parking wasn't the best but it was worth it. #ThankYouThursday2021

It was my first time going in there. I sent there for a Word Connection show they had there. It's a nice place, if you want a small quaint place to vibe and hang out. The food and drinks were really good as well.Definitely won't be my last time going there.

I had originally heard the food was good here while I was visiting the first time. Unfortunately on my first visit I had just ate and only came in for drinks. After my second visit I can indeed confirm that the food is good! On both of my visits the place was clean and great service from the bartenders which makes me want to of course come again and maybe bring some friends along.
